## Episode Thesis

This is a non-investment Friday panel about geopolitics: Trump and Putin both visited Xi Jinping, and the guests argue Europe needs to step up. They also discuss Sweden's SEK 500m aviation support package and the tone of the election campaign. The only market item is Kinnevik: a report that it may recruit former Investor CFO Helena Saxon as CEO, plus the SEK 98m sale of its Skeppsbron property. The panel also touches on Northvolt's bankruptcy and the Swatch x Audemars Piguet launch that ended with tear gas in Paris, but no directional investment views are expressed.
